flattery_warning: Kronos-small (NeoQuasar/Kronos-small) is a pretrained model whose training data is historical market data. Backtest scores are therefore an UPPER BOUND on live skill, not an estimate of it. The forward ledger (issue #79) remains the only basis for accuracy claims (decision D4 unchanged).
exclusions: Out of scope for this backtest (design §5.2): sentiment/news (no complete historical headline archive exists), agent/LLM (training knowledge leaks the future), fundamentals (no verified point-in-time statement vintages), and validation / backtest-category tools (qlib, vectorbt, backtrader) which are not direction voters. Only price-forecast (Kronos) and technicals (pandas-ta voter + talib cross-check) are scored, separately and as a 2-family ensemble.
